breadcrumb: Std 6 Science (English) — Unit 3: Matter Around Us — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: A standard sheet of paper is about millions of atoms thick. Science has come up with a technology to identify the structure of atoms by using Atomic resolution Microscope (ARM) and Tunnelling Electron Microscope (TEM).

en.q: Which instruments are used to map the structure of atoms using electricity?
options: Atomic resolution and scanning tunnelling microscopes
Simple magnifying lens and a compound microscope
en.explanation: These microscopes use electricity (an electron beam or a tunnelling current) to map atoms.

ta.q: அணுக்களின் அமைப்பை மின்சாரம் கொண்டு படமாக்கப் பயன்படும் கருவிகள் எவை?
ta.explanation: இவை மின்சாரத்தை (எலக்ட்ரான் கற்றை அல்லது சுரங்க மின்னோட்டம்) பயன்படுத்தி அணுக்களை வரைபடமாக்குகின்றன.

questions.quote: Matter is defined as anything that occupies space and has mass. Matter is found in three major states: solid, liquid and gas.

en.q: Which of these is a state of matter?
en.explanation: The three states of matter are solid, liquid and gas.

ta.explanation: திண்மம், திரவம், வாயு ஆகியவை பருப்பொருளின் மூன்று நிலைகள்.

questions.quote: 'Liquefaction of gases' is the process by which substances in their gaseous state are converted to the liquid state.

en.q: The process of converting a gas into a liquid is called ______.
en.explanation: On increasing pressure and lowering the temperature, a gas changes into a liquid.

ta.explanation: அழுத்தத்தை அதிகரித்து வெப்பநிலையைக் குறைத்தால் வாயு நீர்மமாகும்.

questions.quote: Example: 22 carat gold which is composed of gold and copper or gold and cadmium.

en.explanation: It is a physical combination of two elements, hence a mixture. (Also: or cadmium.)

ta.explanation: இது இரு தனிமங்களின் இயற்பியல் கலவை. (மேலும்: அல்லது காட்மியம்.)

questions.quote: Tincture of iodine is composed of Iodine in alcohol.

en.q: Tincture of iodine is a mixture of ______.
en.explanation: An element (iodine) and a compound (alcohol) are mixed.

questions.quote: Aerated drink which is composed of carbon dioxide, water, sweetening and colouring agents.

en.q: The gas dissolved in an aerated (soda) drink is ______.
en.explanation: Aerated drinks contain carbon dioxide, water, sweeteners and colouring agents.

ta.explanation: அதில் கார்பன் டை ஆக்சைடு, நீர், இனிப்பு, நிறமூட்டிகள் உள்ளன.

questions.quote: Rice husk also called chaff is the hard coating or protective covering on a seed or grains. Husk can be used as building material, fertilizer, insulation material and fuel.

options: the stalk of the rice plant
the outer covering of a grain
the root of the rice plant
a type of pulse or lentil
en.explanation: Husk protects the seed during the growing season and can be used as fuel and fertilizer.

ta.explanation: உமி விதையைப் பாதுகாக்கும்; எரிபொருளாகவும் உரமாகவும் பயன்படும்.

questions.quote: Used tea leaves are sometimes used as adulterants in tea. Turmeric powder is adulterated with a bright yellow chemical which is poisonous.

en.q: Which of the following is a food adulterant mentioned in the book?
options: Sugar added to the tea cup
Used tea leaves added to fresh tea
en.explanation: Used tea leaves are dried and mixed with fresh tea leaves.

questions.quote: In washing machines water is squeezed out from clothes and they are dried. This method is called centrifugation.

en.q: The method by which washing machines squeeze water out of clothes is called ______.
en.explanation: Washing machines dry clothes by centrifugation.

ta.q: துணி துவைக்கும் இயந்திரத்தில் துணியிலிருந்து நீர் பிழியப்படும் முறை ______.
ta.explanation: துவைக்கும் இயந்திரம் துணியை மையவிலக்கு முறையில் உலர்த்தும். (மேலும்: சுழற்றிப் பிரித்தல்.)

questions.quote: Solids are tightly packed and they do not diffuse like liquids or gases. Particles of gases are arranged far apart and move freely.

en.q: In which state of matter are particles arranged farthest apart?
en.explanation: Gas particles are far apart and move freely.

ta.q: எந்த நிலையில் துகள்கள் மிக அதிக இடைவெளியுடன் அமைந்துள்ளன?
ta.explanation: வாயுத் துகள்கள் தொலைவில் இருந்து தடையின்றி நகரும்.

questions.quote: Air is a mixture because it contains oxygen, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, water vapour, noble gases. Milk is also a mixture. It contains water, fat, protein etc.

en.q: Milk is a mixture because it contains ______.
en.explanation: Milk is a mixture of water, fat, protein, etc.

ta.q: பால் ஒரு கலவை, ஏனெனில் அதில் ______ உள்ளன.
ta.explanation: பாலில் நீர், கொழுப்பு, புரதம் ஆகியவை கலந்துள்ளன.
